display_name: Phase1 fixed joint physical mixture ground test
description: Evaluate frozen source-selected learned physical posterior mixture, blind channel estimator, input gate and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on seven Phase1 ground views; truth last.
authorization: 用户要求研发不同路线的星地恢复网络，只看 Phase1 地面训练测试、使用 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；六场景下降不超过 3%，同时核对百分点和相对百分比口径。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 fixed inference, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL ground base, TF32 disabled; independent CPU truth-last score

data.representation: IQ [2,256], blind physical posterior, source-trained six-component continuous mixture, frozen input gate and F
data.tx_sets_ref: No test truth, clean pair, U_s truth or V during inference; fixed ground test truth after all seven views
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout, previously seen in other source views
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Controller trained using legal L_s fit labels and high-confidence frozen F pseudo labels for U_s; no U_s truth, V or test used in training
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Source-trained frozen candidate, fixed Phase1 ground test inference then truth-last scoring
permissions.query_use: Per-record received IQ and frozen F predictions only; no clean pair, labels or adaptation at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Repeatedly observed single-seed Phase1 ground development test, not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-trained mixture scale1, six-component source posterior, blind estimator, gate .8, frozen F; no DURA inference.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Frozen source mixture training commit c67dc6d7b6a3880ffe2fe4e49357ee4da18eb4ef and fixed source selection scale1 gate0.8, source label audit completed.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source parent-protected selection +27 pseudo matches but not DURA-protected; +2 true L_s RX4/6, 0 RX8, not independent blind.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed scale1, gate .8 from source primary parent criteria; all seven Phase1 views complete before truth.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 after idle check; source-only real model prediction smoke before test; preserve other owners

metric_names: per-view frozen F raw and restored accuracy
per-view clean-relative percentage point and relative percent gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments/phase1_joint_mixture/phase1_predict.py score (independent CPU after all seven predictions complete)
metrics_plan.targets_ref: All six simulated satellite views at most 3 percentage points and 3% relative below F clean; clean output degradation <=1 percentage point

notes: No test truth or model update during prediction; candidate never calls DURA.

Replay 1047 fixed source predictions on real checkpoint and gate before ground test.
